reporting_protocol.primary_endpoint: Native COCO AP, selected maximum validation AP over 160 epochs
reporting_protocol.selection: All seeds fixed before launch; no ranking-dependent seed inclusion
reporting_protocol.summaries: Per-seed values; mean, sample SD and Student-t 95% CI for fixed 0/1/2 and all 0..4
reporting_protocol.failed_seeds: Recorded explicitly; no replacement seed or result-conditioned retry
reporting_protocol.dataset_policy: Existing images, partitions and FDI maps preserved; internal validation only
reporting_protocol.configuration_selection: Mobile tau=.50 and DSLR decay-only chosen using prior single-seed ablations; not independent confirmatory test evidence

checkpoint_policy: Preserve native stage1 rollback temporarily; after exact EMA replay retain best.pth only
scheduling: Two detached workers share atomic task claims; wait for GPU with no other compute processes

cost_estimate.note: Estimate excludes time waiting for unrelated GPU1 job
